title: PsyTwin-SDE (v1.0.0): Psychometric filtering and neuroaxonal biomarker profiling guide equitable brain-aging trajectory modeling
description: Open-source Python implementation and verification suite for PsyTwin-SDE, a psychometric-physics-aware continuous-time coupled stochastic differential equation digital twin integrating US NHANES 24-hour wrist actigraphy, serum neurofilament light chain (sNfL), and zero-ceiling neurocognition with nine-year five-wave CHARLS trajectories across two independent national cohorts (NHANES N = 8,148; CHARLS N = 20,928).
